weather.source: CAB/INTA-supplied REMS daily weather reports served by NASA/JPL; scientific archive: PDS Atmospheres

by_season.air_temp_min_c_method: Minimum of daily REMS air-temperature minima (degrees C) in this 30-degree Ls bin; NASA feed supplied by CAB/INTA.
by_season.air_temp_max_c_method: Maximum of daily REMS air-temperature maxima (degrees C) in this 30-degree Ls bin; NASA feed supplied by CAB/INTA.
by_season.pressure_pa_method: Arithmetic mean of daily mean REMS pressure values (Pa) in this 30-degree Ls bin; NASA feed supplied by CAB/INTA.
by_season.uv_method: Most frequent reported daily local UV irradiance category in this 30° Ls bin; unknown when none is available.
by_season.n_sols_method: Count of distinct mission sols with numeric Ls, temperature extrema and pressure in the CAB/INTA-supplied NASA feed.

latest.sol_method: Mission sol number as reported by the CAB/INTA-supplied NASA weather feed.
latest.air_temp_min_c_method: Latest available daily REMS minimum air temperature (degrees C) from the CAB/INTA-supplied NASA feed.
latest.air_temp_max_c_method: Latest available daily REMS maximum air temperature (degrees C) from the CAB/INTA-supplied NASA feed.
latest.pressure_pa_method: Latest available daily REMS mean pressure (Pa) from the CAB/INTA-supplied NASA feed.

radiation.surface_dose_mgy_per_day_method: Median of 2806 per-sol mean filtered RAD E-dose rates; each mean uses the filtered-dose column in µGy/day, converted to mGy/day. Elevated rate is the highest per-sol mean in the same record series.
radiation.solar_event_mgy_per_day_method: Maximum per-sol mean filtered RAD dose rate; data-derived elevated proxy, not an event-specific reconstruction. Median of 2806 per-sol mean filtered RAD E-dose rates; each mean uses the filtered-dose column in µGy/day, converted to mGy/day. Elevated rate is the highest per-sol mean in the same record series.
radiation.note: Measured at Gale. Both values are derived from filtered RAD dose records.

dust.source: Mars Climate Database dust climatology (Montabone et al.)

by_season.opacity_method: Mean local-surface column dust optical depth (cdodtot), nearest 2° Montabone climatology grid cell to Gale, pooled over available Mars years and Ls samples in this bin.
by_season.storm_fraction_method: Fraction of available climatology Ls samples in this bin with local-surface CDOD ≥ 1.0; operational threshold stated here as the storm proxy.
